description: Variation of Condition 2 of planning permission ref: 2016/01450/FUL granted 26/03/2018 for the 'Erection of a part single, part found storey building to provide 14 residential dwellings and 13 car parking spaces following the demolition of the existing tennants hall and caretakers office, incorporating office space for the use of Yarrow Housing (Class B1a), a replacement community hall and function room (Class D1) and new external play area; single storey storage building and WC; associated Cycle Parking and Refuse Storage'. Amendments include alterations to the application boundary, alterations to the community hall in South-East corner, upgrade play area, alteratio to window at ground floor level in West Elevation (Warple Way).
